# Which tunes make your shop money, and how many does the winter have to sell?

> Free ski and snowboard tune shop calculator: enter tune prices, bench minutes, materials, technician pay, grinder and rent, and see profit per tune and per bench hour, break-even volume and the season result. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/ski-snowboard-tune-shop-profit-calculator/)
